note: RV and tent camping beside a kayak outfitter and grill on the Barren Fork River in downtown McMinnville. The RV lots are small and close together, set back from the river (the tent sites line the bank); on summer weekends kayakers park in the common areas by day. CAVEAT: reviewers note a narrow, steep entrance road tricky for larger RVs. --Claude
